content: restic (official backup docs): no --include flag; includes are path arguments or --files-from variants. Excludes use Go filepath.Match plus ** (must be a whole path component), matched against full paths; leading / anchors at root; excluded directories are not traversed; gitignore-style ! negation can cancel earlier matches but nothing inside an already-excluded directory can be re-included. Explicitly named source files bypass excludes entirely (pitfall for path-selection-driven backups). --exclude-caches skips dirs containing CACHEDIR.TAG; --exclude-if-present, --exclude-larger-than exist. No default exclusion patterns.
